nodes.label: Shajgoj.bd Favicon (Final)
nodes.description: High-res square brand favicon/logo mark on a transparent background: two offset half-rings, a pink gradient upper arc and a gold gradient lower arc, shifted horizontally so together they read as a stylized 'S' ring for Shajgoj.

nodes.label: Stylized S Ring Monogram
nodes.rationale: Splitting a ring into two offset semicircles makes an abstract 'S' for Shajgoj. It is a simple geometric shape that stays readable at small favicon sizes.

nodes.label: Pink-Gold Brand Gradient Palette
nodes.rationale: A soft-to-deep pink gradient (about #E6B8BE to #E86A88) paired with a gold gradient (about #B38B3C to #F0D478) suggests beauty/cosmetics and a premium feel, which suits a beauty e-commerce brand.
